newsitem.title: USA: Parker Drilling gets Kazakstan contract.
newsitem.headline: Parker Drilling gets Kazakstan contract.

text.p: Parker Drilling Co said Tuesday it received a five-year contract to expand operations in Kazakstan.
The new agreement, it said, creates a broad alliance between it and Tengizchevroil, which is developing the Tengiz Oil Field.
Tengizchevroil is a joint venture between the Republic of Kazakstan, Chevron Corp's Chevron Overseas Petroleum Inc and Mobil Corp's Mobil Oil Co.
As a partner in the alliance, Parker will operate and maintain Tengizchevroil rigs as Tengizchevroil expands operations to include a deep drilling program.

In addition, Parker will manage the customer's warehouse, drilling base and mud plant. It also will provide local and expatriate drilling crews, as well as maintenance personnel for Tengizchevroil's mobile equipment fleet.
Parker is a worldwide energy company specializing in land drilling, barge and offshore platofrm drilling and oil tool rentals.
